import importlib.util
import json
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
SCRIPT_DIR = ROOT / "scripts"
sys.path.insert(0, str(SCRIPT_DIR))
SCRIPT_PATH = SCRIPT_DIR / "validate_seed_task_contracts.py"
SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("seed_task_contracts_java", SCRIPT_PATH)
MODULE = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
assert SPEC and SPEC.loader
sys.modules[SPEC.name] = MODULE
SPEC.loader.exec_module(MODULE)


class JavaRuntimeSeedTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.source = json.loads(
            (ROOT / "db" / "seeds" / "test" / "sources" / "engine-java-runtime-fixtures.json").read_text(
                encoding="utf-8"
            )
        )
        self.task = self.source["lessons"][0]["tasks"][0]
        self.contract = self.task["code_structure"]

    def test_literal_solution_satisfies_compile_and_runtime_stages(self):
        workspace = {
            "Main.java": (
                "public class Main {\n"
                "    public static void main(String[] args) {\n"
                '        System.out.println("Hello, Ada!");\n'
                "    }\n"
                "}\n"
            )
        }

        self.assertTrue(MODULE.validate_validation_contract(self.task, self.contract, workspace))

    def test_all_three_seed_variants_have_a_passing_literal_solution(self):
        self.assertEqual(len(self.source["lessons"]), 3)
        for lesson in self.source["lessons"]:
            task = lesson["tasks"][0]
            contract = task["code_structure"]
            expected = contract["stages"][1]["checks"]["expect"]["stdoutEquals"].removesuffix("\n")
            workspace = {
                "Main.java": (
                    "public class Main {\n"
                    "    public static void main(String[] args) {\n"
                    f"        System.out.println({json.dumps(expected)});\n"
                    "    }\n"
                    "}\n"
                )
            }
            with self.subTest(expected=expected):
                self.assertTrue(MODULE.validate_validation_contract(task, contract, workspace))

    def test_compile_error_output_mismatch_and_superficial_answer_fail(self):
        cases = (
            {
                "Main.java": (
                    "public class Main {\n"
                    "    public static void main(String[] args) {\n"
                    '        System.out.println("Hello, Ada!")\n'
                    "    }\n"
                    "}\n"
                )
            },
            {
                "Main.java": (
                    "public class Main {\n"
                    "    public static void main(String[] args) {\n"
                    '        System.out.println("TODO");\n'
                    "    }\n"
                    "}\n"
                )
            },
            {
                "Main.java": (
                    "public class Main {\n"
                    "    public static void main(String[] args) {\n"
                    '        String expected = "Hello, Ada!";\n'
                    "    }\n"
                    "}\n"
                )
            },
        )

        for workspace in cases:
            with self.subTest(source=workspace["Main.java"]):
                self.assertFalse(MODULE.validate_validation_contract(self.task, self.contract, workspace))

    def test_generated_starter_compiles_but_does_not_pass_final_behavior(self):
        workspace = {"Main.java": MODULE.file_content("Main.java", {"code": "JAVA_BASIC_SCRIPT"})}

        self.assertTrue(
            MODULE.validate_java_compile_contract_stage(self.contract["stages"][0], workspace)
        )
        self.assertFalse(MODULE.validate_validation_contract(self.task, self.contract, workspace))

    def test_java_validator_route_imports_the_runtime_fixture_source(self):
        route = json.loads(
            (ROOT / "db" / "seeds" / "test" / "routes" / "java-validators.json").read_text(
                encoding="utf-8"
            )
        )

        self.assertEqual(route["slug"], "java-validators")
        self.assertEqual(route["main_tech_label"], "java")
        self.assertEqual(
            route["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["source_slug"],
            "engine-java-runtime-fixtures",
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
